verdict.rationale: Weave itself is an observability/eval dashboard with no native chat-command interface, but an official MCP server lets AI coding agents like Claude Code read production data, run evaluations, and iterate automatically using natural-language instructions relayed through MCP tools. This gives indirect NL-driven operation rather than a first-party conversational control surface. Missing for 10: a built-in Weave chat/NL console, independent hands-on verification of the MCP-driven workflow, and broader agent support beyond Claude Code.
